name: spread
description: Crie visualizações elegantes de links com customização completa
author: mafhper

scripts.dev:safe: bun run quality:full && bun run dev
scripts.build:prod: bun run build && run-p lint type-check format:check test:core quality:core:quick-silent
scripts.security:audit:root: bun audit --json > audit-root.json && node quality-core/scripts/check-audit.js audit-root.json
scripts.security:audit:dashboard: cd quality-core/dashboard && npm audit --json > audit-dashboard.json && node ../../quality-core/scripts/check-audit.js audit-dashboard.json
scripts.security:audit: bun run security:audit:root && bun run security:audit:dashboard
scripts.security:update: bun install && cd quality-core/dashboard && npm update
scripts.quality:check: run-p lint type-check format:check test security:audit
scripts.quality:full: rimraf dist && run-p lint type-check format:check test:core quality:core
scripts.quality:full:silent: rimraf dist && run-p lint type-check format:check test:core 'quality:core:silent'
scripts.quality:full:quick: rimraf dist && run-p lint type-check format:check test:core 'quality:core:quick'
scripts.quality:full:quick-silent: rimraf dist && run-p lint type-check format:check test:core 'quality:core:quick-silent'
scripts.quality:reports:all: bun run quality:core && bun run quality:lighthouse && bun run quality:snapshot && bun run analysis
scripts.quality:reports:all:silent: bun run quality:core:silent && bun run quality:lighthouse:silent && bun run analysis:silent && bun quality-core/generate-snapshot.ts
scripts.quality:ci: bun run quality:full && bun run quality:reports:all
scripts.quality:ci:quick-silent: bun run build && node quality-core/cli/run.cjs --quick --silent && node quality-core/cli/quality.cjs --quick --silent && node quality-core/cli/run-lighthouse.cjs --silent && node quality-core/cli/run-analysis.cjs --silent
